technical_and_design_decisions: Target product is Spring XD (Spring eXtreme Data) — the spec's user stories reference XD, not core Spring Framework
Build system assumed to be Gradle (typical for Spring XD); Windows port requires CRLF handling, path-separator fixes, and removal of Unix-only shell commands
Spark Streaming processors implemented as XD Module plugins (one in Java, one in Scala) registered through XD's module SPI
Kafka upgrade uses Spring Integration Kafka (SI Kafka) as the bridge, with XD Kafka code backported before bumping to GA
SHDP (Spring for Apache Hadoop) GA bump treated as a dependency/artifact upgrade in the XD build files plus integration smoke tests
Windows acceptance testing executed on EC2 Windows AMI; CI integration done by adding a new Windows agent job to the existing pipeline (e.g., Jenkins/Concourse)
Pig job sample provided as a runnable XD tap/source module with accompanying documentation, not a full Pig engine integration
Migration guide (U1) delivered as a section in the reference guide and a sample ported custom module demonstrating API deltas between XD 1.0 and 1.1
Copyright text update (U6) applied at the Asciidoctor source level so PDF regeneration picks it up automatically
assumptions: A single experienced developer familiar with Spring XD, Kafka, Spark Streaming, Hadoop, and the XD module API performs all work
Spark Streaming GA bits (and a compatible Scala runtime) are already available in public Maven repositories
Kafka SI GA and SHDP GA artifacts are available in Spring's release repository at the time of work
The existing XD acceptance-test suite is largely platform-agnostic; only path/script glue needs adjustment for Windows
EC2 Windows AMIs are already available; no procurement or licensing work is required
Reference guide PDF is generated from Asciidoctor sources, so only the source change is in scope for U6
One work-hour equals one productive person-hour; estimates exclude meetings, waiting time, and context switching
No production hardening, security review, or large-scale performance testing is in scope beyond smoke/acceptance tests

activities.activity_description: Review the eight user stories, study the existing XD 1.1 codebase, identify affected modules, and produce a short technical design note covering the Spark Streaming module shape, Kafka SI backport scope, and Windows build/test strategy.

activities.activity_name: U1 — XD 1.0 to 1.1 migration guide and sample ported module
activities.activity_description: Document the API/config deltas between XD 1.0 and 1.1 and provide one sample custom module that is ported across versions, demonstrating the migration steps end users should follow.

activities.activity_name: U2 — Pig script/job sample for XD integration
activities.activity_description: Author a runnable Pig script sample, wrap it as an XD job module (or document the command-line invocation), and write a short reference describing how to integrate Pig jobs into an XD stream/batch pipeline.

activities.activity_name: U3 — Windows build support for XD
activities.activity_description: Fix Gradle build scripts, shell wrappers, and any Unix-only utilities (e.g., sed/awk usage, POSIX paths) so the XD build runs end-to-end on a Windows developer machine; verify with a clean local build on Windows.

activities.activity_name: U4 — Windows acceptance test on EC2 and CI build job
activities.activity_description: Provision a Windows EC2 instance, port the acceptance test runner to Windows, execute the suite, fix platform-specific failures, and wire the run as a new job in the existing CI pipeline so it executes on every change.

activities.activity_name: U5 — Spark Streaming processor implementation (Java/Java 8 Lambdas)
activities.activity_description: Implement the Spark Streaming data-processor module in Java using the Java 8 Lambda-friendly XD module APIs; cover the typical stream→RDD and RDD→stream conversion paths.

activities.activity_name: U5 — Spark Streaming processor implementation (Scala variant)
activities.activity_description: Provide the Scala counterpart of the Java processor, leveraging Scala collections and Spark's Scala DSL while still conforming to the XD module contract.

activities.activity_name: U5 — Tests for Spark Streaming processors
activities.activity_description: Write unit tests for the processor logic and an integration test that drives both Java and Scala variants against a local Spark Streaming context, validating input/output payloads.

activities.activity_name: U5 — Documentation for Spark Streaming processors
activities.activity_description: Add a reference-guide section explaining configuration options, deployment topology, and a worked example for the new Spark Streaming processors.

activities.activity_name: U6 — Copyright year update in reference guide (PDF)
activities.activity_description: Change '2014' to '2015' in the Asciidoctor source for the reference guide footer/header, regenerate the PDF, and verify the change is visible.

activities.activity_name: U7 — Backport Kafka XD changes to Spring Integration Kafka
activities.activity_description: Identify the Kafka-specific XD code paths that diverged from SI Kafka, port relevant features/fixes back into the SI Kafka project, and verify equivalence with a regression run.

activities.activity_name: U7 — Upgrade XD to Kafka SI GA release
activities.activity_description: Bump the SI Kafka dependency to the GA version, adapt XD's Kafka adapter module to any API changes, and run the Kafka-related acceptance tests.

activities.activity_name: U8 — Upgrade XD to SHDP GA release
activities.activity_description: Update the Spring Hadoop (SHDP) dependency to its GA version, fix any breaking changes in XD's Hadoop module, and run the Hadoop-related smoke/acceptance tests.
Execute the full XD acceptance test suite (Linux and Windows) covering the new Spark Streaming processors, the upgraded Kafka and Hadoop adapters, and the Pig sample end-to-end.

activities.activity_name: Release notes and final documentation pass
activities.activity_description: Update the release notes for XD 1.1, review all newly added/updated reference-guide pages, and produce a short changelog entry covering U1–U8.
